title: The Law of the Firstborn's Inheritance
description: The law states that when a man has two wives, one he loves and one he does not love, and both have borne him sons, and the firstborn is the son of the wife he does not love, he may not give the birthright to the son of the wife he loves on the day he distributes his inheritance. He must recognize the firstborn as the son of the unloved wife and give him a double portion of all that he has, for he is the firstfruits of his strength, and the right of the firstborn belongs to him.
